sections.title: How a custom program runs
sections.body: Sample timing depends on complexity; bulk starts after sample approval and material lock.
items: Receive & review tech pack — We check drawings, BOM, and construction notes for feasibility and cost drivers.
Pattern & material confirmation — Patterns are refined; materials and hardware are locked with your approval.
Prototype / sample — You receive wearable or sales samples for fit, look, and function sign-off.
Bulk production — Confirmed specs go to the line with in-process checks.
QC & packing — Final inspection, branding inserts, and export-ready packing.
Shipping & documents — Cartons, labels, and commercial documents prepared for your destination.

sections.title: First quote
sections.body: A factory quote starts from the style in front of us.
items: What information do you need for a first quote? — Style photos or tech pack, target materials, approximate MOQ, and destination market.
Do you support OEM and ODM? — Yes—build from your design, or develop with our sampling team.
Can you work with vegan materials? — Yes—PU and other alternatives alongside leather programs.
How do sampling and bulk lead times work? — Sample timing depends on complexity; bulk starts after sample approval and material lock.

sections.title: MOQ, terms, logo, shipping
sections.body: Opening quantities and commercial terms are written per program.
items: What is your MOQ? — Start with workable trial runs, then scale when your line is ready.
How do payment terms work? — Commercial terms sit on each written quotation.
Which logo methods can you run? — Logo methods are confirmed per style during sampling, against the face material.
Where do you ship? — Cartons, labels, and commercial documents are prepared for your destination.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How AtelierBag OEM handles enquiry data.
privacy.content: AtelierBag OEM uses the contact details you submit to reply to quotes and project briefs. We do not sell enquiry data. To update or delete information, write to sales@atelierbag-oem.com.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: Terms for using the AtelierBag OEM website.
terms.content: Content on this website is for product information and enquiry. Specifications, opening quantities, and lead times are confirmed in writing on each quotation. Nothing here is a binding offer. Commercial terms sit on documents issued by AtelierBag Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
